change.kind: runtime and public admin UI pagination; tests; scoped canonical plan acceptance and evidence
change.behavior: The editor can traverse every site-scoped retention request beyond the prior 100-row cap. The API uses a keyset cursor on requested_at DESC/id DESC, rejects malformed, repeated, missing and foreign-site cursors before listing, and returns a next cursor only when more rows exist. The accessible control appends pages without duplicates, preserves confirmed rows on page errors, permits explicit retry, refreshes to page one, and restores keyboard focus when the final page hides the control.
change.data_safety: All new reads are SELECT-only. No D1 migration/write or R2 read/write/delete. Cancellation remains an explicit separate action and never authorizes deletion. Save and Publish stay distinct.
change.database_index: Added idx_media_retention_status_page to the existing manual-only schema proposal and checked its use in SQLite EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN. It is not applied to production. Production preflight found the retention table but not this index; the query remains functionally valid without schema changes, though the proposed index should be present before growth makes site-list sorting material.
